text: Love the smell of Vicks? Put one of these in your shower. Eucalyptus and essential oils, plus menthol and camphor scents. The Plus has ten percent more of that blend than the original. Set it on the shower floor, right in the stream. It dissolves and infuses the steam. Just know it's non-medicated. It's for the scent, not a cold remedy. Not a Vicks person? Skip this. If you are, it's in the orange cart.
